contract.promotion_condition: A schema-valid verification_pass=true receipt, atomically published only after the verifier releases the canonical full-1G lock, may authorize freezing an independent Arm B plan that binds both the Arm-A source receipt and this verification. It does not qualify q1.
contract.kill_condition: Any source failure, artifact drift, plan activation mismatch, live qm8 process, counter inconsistency, cleanup gap, accounting mismatch, or verifier/schema hash drift stops the A-to-B transition.

activation_requirements: Do not execute revision 1. The verifier rejects any plan revision below 2 or execution_authorized=false before opening the output path.
Wait for the exact qm8 Arm-A terminal receipt and require terminal_pass=true with descriptor-bound receipt identity and the shared terminal-closure proof.
Require the terminal dispatcher activation receipt to bind this exact revision-2 plan, its intent, the unchanged failure plan, and the same terminal receipt.
Create revision 2 by changing only activation status, execution authority, revision, and the terminal receipt SHA-256 unless a bound implementation file has actually drifted.

Execute only the exact frozen runtime and argv while the canonical output is absent; prepare and fsync the complete receipt under the full-1G lock, release that lock, then atomically publish the canonical path without replacement.
claim_boundary: Revision 1 is dormant and has no execution authority.
A future passing verification proves one diagnostic full-corpus Arm A only and can authorize an independent unchanged Arm B plan.
It cannot establish Arm-B determinism, continuous probability/state identity, runtime eligibility, parent qualification, Gamma authorship, or Hutter score credit.
